patthana12.5:4.1: Nahetuṃ nocittasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nahetuṃ nacittasaṃsaṭṭhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe…
patthana12.5:6.1: Nahetuṃ nacittasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nahetuṃ nacittānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.5:7.1: Nahetuṃ nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nahetuṃ nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānasahabhuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nahetuṃ nacittasaṃsaṭṭhasamuṭṭhānānuparivattiṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca….
patthana12.5:13.1: Nahetuṃ noupādānaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe… nahetuṃ nokilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca…pe….
